description: This file defines the AddressWritePlatformService interface, which provides methods for adding and updating client address information within the Fineract system.
external_methods: JsonCommand (constructor or methods within the class)

classes.name: AddressWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining address management operations such as adding and updating client addresses.

methods.name: addClientAddress
methods.description: Adds an address for a client given the client ID, address type ID, and command containing address details.

methods.name: addNewClientAddress
methods.description: Adds a new address to a client using a Client object and a command with address details.

methods.name: updateClientAddress
methods.description: Updates an existing client address based on client ID and provided command.
